name: Process & Window Observer
purpose: Snapshot running processes and top-level windows (pids, titles, paths, positions/size, minimized/maximized, the foreground window) via structured OS queries — no screenshots or image processing.

inputs.name: visible_only
inputs.description: Only enumerate visible top-level windows that have a title.

inputs.name: name_filter
inputs.description: Optional glob on process name to narrow processes and windows.

inputs.name: max_items
inputs.description: Cap on processes/windows; exceeding sets status=partial.

outputs.description: { host, generated_at_utc, name_filter, visible_only, process_count, window_count, foreground, windows[] }
